description: This Java source file defines a Fragment named LogFragment which manages a LogView inside a ScrollView for displaying log data within an Android application. It includes methods for creating and inflating the view hierarchy, setting up UI elements like padding and typeface, and updating the scroll position when text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that contains a LogView inside a ScrollView to display log output. Provides UI setup and text change handling to ensure logs are visible and scrollable.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures a ScrollView containing a LogView, setting layout parameters, padding, typeface, and gravity.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll when log text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
